title: Abstention Is Not Threshold Compliance: Stated Scoring Rules in Open Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kalai et al. propose stating the scoring rule in the prompt with an explicit threshold t, so that a model should answer only when its probability of being correct exceeds t. We probe each requirement of compliance on shared items, in 12 checkpoints from three post-training stages of four fully open 3-8B recipes, with exploratory models up to 32B. At t = 0.75, a line limiting the reply to an answer or "I abstain" (the abstention format) raised the mean abstention rate from 20% to 91%. Yet within this format, raising t from 0.5 to 0.9 changed it by only -0.8 percentage points. Without the line, the higher threshold even lowered abstention, and up to 40% of a checkpoint's items received decisions that no compliant policy with threshold-independent beliefs could make. translated_title: 弃答并非阈值遵从：开放语言模型中的明示评分规则
translated_abstract: Kalai 等人提议在提示词中声明评分规则并附上明确阈值 t，要求模型仅在其回答正确的概率超过 t 时才作答。我们在共享题目上对遵从该规则的各项要求逐一进行了探究，测试对象涵盖四个完全开放的 3-8B 模型配方在三个后训练阶段的 12 个检查点，以及参数量最高达 32B 的探索性模型。在 t = 0.75 时，提示中加入一行限制回复只能是答案或“我弃答”的说明（即弃答格式），使平均弃答率从 20% 升至 91%。然而在此格式下，将 t 从 0.5 提高到 0.9，弃答率仅变化了 -0.8 个百分点；而在没有该行时，更高的阈值反而降低了弃答率，且每个检查点中最多有 40% 的题目得到了任何信念不随阈值变化的遵从策略都不可能作出的决策。在给定其回答正确概率的条件下，各检查点在强制选择题探测中几乎对阈值毫无响应。与诸如自我评估信号的比较……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 开放语言模型虽能在“弃答格式”提示下将弃答率从 20% 大幅提升至 91%，但其弃答行为几乎不受所声明阈值 t 的影响，表明模型的弃答只是对输出格式的遵从，而非对明示评分规则阈值的真正遵从。
en_tdlr: Open language models sharply raise abstention from 20% to 91% when given an abstention-format instruction, yet their abstention barely responds to the stated threshold t, showing that abstention reflects mere format compliance rather than genuine compliance with the stated scoring rule.
